rule.name: stable_fifo_execution_signature_candidate_cache
rule.equivalence_key: right-pad a logical raw lane prefix with idle, then use aggregate service, effective frame duration, and each class's completion offsets concatenated in raw lane order and stored within-option order
rule.paid_budget: all-idle and one homogeneous seed per option, then the first logical search occurrence of each previously unseen equivalence key
rule.free_reuse: reuse feasibility, service, numerator, duration, and score for later raw actions with exactly the same FIFO execution signature; still expand the original logical prefix
rule.post_budget_drain: after K paid attempts, process consecutive frontier cache hits until the next cache miss or exact termination
rule.raw_witness: apply each encountered ordered tuple to the unchanged v4 score-duration-raw-index tie break
rule.unchanged: homogeneous seed order, queue-dependent local order, logical prefix tree, feasibility, support objective, suffix bound, and strict bound pruning
rule.seed_accounting: all-idle and all nine homogeneous option seeds remain paid even if seed signatures collide
rule.cache_key_excludes: sorted completion-offset multisets and raw option identity beyond their exact FIFO execution effect
rule.exact_cap: the frozen two-lane catalogue has 100 raw actions and 71 FIFO execution signatures, so K71 exhausts support-relevant signatures
rule.exact_semantics: exact certifies maximum one-frame support; because this selector freezes the legacy logical heap, order, and paid-candidate tie rule, execution integrity separately requires K71 raw, physical, and FIFO witnesses to match registered legacy K120 on every state

signature_schema.raw: right-padded original option-index tuple, with None denoting idle
signature_schema.physical: aggregate service, duration, and sorted completion-offset multiset per class
signature_schema.fifo_execution: aggregate service, duration, and FIFO-ordered completion-offset sequence per class

protocol.stopping_rule: run this fixed rule once on the registered 5,003 states; invalid execution gives INVALID_EXECUTION; all fixed gates plus both strict gains and at least one FIFO-effective change give ADVANCE_TO_EVIDENCE_REUSE_OR_AUTHORED_TRANSITION; nonworse certificate or attempt gain without support gain or FIFO-effective change gives EFFICIENCY_ONLY_STOP; all other outcomes give CLOSE_WITHOUT_TRANSITION_SCREEN
